families.current: Role labels are separate from baseline phase scheduling. Current condition objects have id/label/role only. Legacy paired comparison has a rationale. Subtractive pupil mapping requires a distinct phase/window, coverage/duration and provenance; no design baseline value is automatically substituted.
prospective: Versioned control rationale and properties deliberately matched/manipulated
Recorded baseline identity/context/quality and selected analysis transform, kept separate from a display phase
families.consumer_transfer: Choose controls for the particular manipulation and question. Matching all properties is not required when a property is the manipulation; role labels do not establish causality.
families.gap: No independent exact starter/control/blank-baseline validation; no automatic sensor recording or baseline quality guarantee.

families.current: Defaults are 5000/0/500 ms; positive baseline precedes fixation then exposure then after_each response. No separate acclimatisation/washout field in this stimulus-loop schema. Browser events report requestAnimationFrame-before-paint observation, not physical onset. EDA event windows are separately declared and checked.
prospective: Separate acclimatisation, recorded baseline, exposure, response and recovery purposes in a new protocol contract
Method/context-specific duration and overlap rationale; observed onset/offset and deviations
families.consumer_transfer: Auditory tone intervals and HRV posture recommendations cannot directly establish advertising/packaging/UX timing. Repetition and questions may alter later response context.
families.gap: No universal duration, physical timing or context-specific physiological settling qualification; after_each self-paced time is not automatically washout.

families.current: Rotation is over stimuli, not condition labels. Two stimuli give AB/BA across allocation indices, never four-trial ABBA. More stimuli use cyclic rotations. Randomized order is a seeded per-allocation shuffle. Delivery count covers started allocations, not only completions.
prospective: Named sequence algorithm with explicit predecessor order/repetition/self-adjacency assumptions
Separate assigned, completed and usable order counts; dropout/exclusion policy
Allocation unit and concealment/randomization purpose distinguished from reproducible presentation order
families.consumer_transfer: Within-person comparisons can change context and learning. Decide whether sequential comparison matches real consumer exposure; neither rotation nor shuffle removes persistent/asymmetric effects.
families.gap: No general higher-order carryover balance, between-person group assignment, achieved usable balance or concealment claim.

families.current: paired-consumer-comparisons/1.0-draft averages condition values per session, differences per person and then people. Planned Student t inference uses those person differences. It does not model random stimulus variation. At least two people is a computational eligibility condition, not a sample-size recommendation.
prospective: Explicit fixed-stimulus versus sampled-stimulus estimand and recruitment/stimulus-sampling rationale
New versioned participant×stimulus model and uncertainty/precision design when generalisation requires it
families.consumer_transfer: A conclusion about the particular presented concepts is narrower than a population of adverts/packages. Repeated visits are not extra independent people, and more people alone need not resolve stimulus uncertainty.
families.gap: Current participant aggregation is not declared erroneous. No automatic mixed-model choice, consumer population inference, universal n or new numerical/scientific qualification follows.
